description: This file implements an in-memory data layer with async JSON read/write, atomic file operations, seed hydration, cache management, and validation utilities for lessons, quizzes, progress, and enrollments in a learning platform.

methods.name: ensureDirSync
methods.description: Synchronously ensures that a directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: readJsonSafe
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a JSON file safely, returning null if reading or parsing fails.

methods.name: writeJsonAtomic
methods.description: Writes JSON data atomically by writing to a temp file and renaming it.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Returns the default in-memory state object with empty arrays for lessons, quizzes, progress, and enrollments.

methods.name: validateLesson
methods.description: Validates the shape of a lesson object.

methods.name: validateQuiz
methods.description: Validates the shape of a quiz object.

methods.name: validateProgress
methods.description: Validates the shape of a progress record.

methods.name: validateEnrollment
methods.description: Validates the shape of an enrollment record.

methods.name: sanitizeDBShape
methods.description: Sanitizes and filters a database object to ensure correct shape and valid data.

methods.name: initStore
methods.description: Initializes the in-memory store by loading or creating the database JSON file, with seed hydration if needed.

methods.name: readDB
methods.description: Returns the current in-memory database state, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: writeQueued
methods.description: Enqueues a write operation to persist the database state atomically.

methods.name: writeDB
methods.description: Sanitizes and updates the in-memory cache, then persists it to disk.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current in-memory state.

methods.name: upsertProgress
methods.description: Adds or updates a progress record with validation.

methods.name: enrollUser
methods.description: Enrolls a user into a lesson, validating the data.

methods.name: getEnrollmentsByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all enrollments for a specific user.
